TTSMODEL_SIG.title: Voice model configuration is incompatible
TTSMODEL_SIG.summary: The selected voice model could not be loaded with the current configuration.
likely_causes: The model name or model signature in the configuration is invalid.
The installed TTS package does not support this model.
The selected model files are incomplete or damaged.
steps: Open the Models panel and select a supported model.
If the model is already selected, download it again from the Models panel.
Restart the application and retry the operation.

JSONCONFIG_NR.title: A configured path could not be resolved
JSONCONFIG_NR.summary: A path value required by the application is missing or could not be found.
likely_causes: The configuration contains a blank or outdated path.
The game or mod was moved after configuration.
The current Windows account cannot access the configured folder.
steps: Open System Settings > Paths and review the configured folders.
Select the correct game or mod folder and save the settings.
Restart the application, then retry.

JSONCONFIG_NP.title: A configuration path is invalid
JSONCONFIG_NP.summary: A configured path does not point to a usable location.
likely_causes: The configured folder does not exist.
The folder is not writable or is on an unavailable drive.
The path contains a typo or refers to an old installation.
steps: Open System Settings > Paths and check the folder shown in the error.
Choose an existing folder that the current Windows account can access.
Save settings and restart the application.

DSV2WEM_NF.title: The WEM conversion tool is unavailable
DSV2WEM_NF.summary: The required audio converter could not be located.
likely_causes: Setup did not complete or the converter download is missing.
The configured tool folder was moved or removed.
Security software quarantined a downloaded tool.
steps: Run the project installer again from the extracted project folder.
Check the installer output for a failed download or setup step.
If security software quarantined a file, review its report and restore only if you trust the source.

WAV2WEM_FAIL.title: Audio conversion failed
WAV2WEM_FAIL.summary: The WAV-to-WEM conversion process exited unsuccessfully.
likely_causes: The source WAV is invalid, empty, or incomplete.
The converter cannot access its input or output folder.
The converter reported an unsupported format or another conversion error.
steps: Retry the same item and note the source filename and complete converter output.
Check that the configured game and output folders exist and are writable.
If the problem repeats, open a GitHub issue with this token and the relevant log excerpt.

LLMINFERENCE_FAIL.title: Voice generation failed
LLMINFERENCE_FAIL.summary: The speech model could not generate audio after its retry attempts.
likely_causes: The configured local language model file is missing or damaged.
The input text or voice settings are not accepted by the model.
The computer ran out of memory while generating audio.
steps: Check the configured models.llm_model file path in config/environment_config.json.
Try a short test phrase and check the application logs for the complete model error.
Restart the application to release memory, then try again.

TRAYWATCHER_EXC.title: The background watcher encountered an error
TRAYWATCHER_EXC.summary: The watcher failed while processing an item. Other items may continue to be monitored.
likely_causes: The current source file is incomplete or unreadable.
A required folder or conversion tool is unavailable.
An unexpected processing error occurred.
steps: Check the application log for the filename and underlying error.
Verify the configured game and mod paths in System Settings > Paths.
Retry after the source file has finished being written. If it repeats, open a GitHub issue with this token.

generic.title: No matching help entry
generic.summary: This token is not in the built-in help catalog. A generated DSV token may have a private local diagnostic report.
likely_causes: The application version that produced the token is newer than this help catalog.
The token was copied incompletely or contains extra text.
steps: Copy the complete token and enter it again.
For a generated DSV token, use the local diagnostic details shown below.
If the issue persists, open a GitHub issue and include the token, application version, and relevant log excerpt.
